accepted.name: dim_academic_terms_current
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  academic_terms.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY,
  academic_terms.TERM_CODE,
  academic_terms.TERM_DESCRIPTION,
  academic_terms.TERM_START_DATE,
  academic_terms.TERM_END_DATE,
  academic_terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  academic_terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  academic_terms.IS_CURRENT_TERM,
  academic_terms.IS_REGULAR_TERM,
  academic_terms.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR,
  academic_terms.TERM_STATUS,
  academic_terms.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM academic_terms
WHERE (academic_terms.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' OR academic_terms.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y')
accepted.description: One-row-per-term dimension filtered to currently-active or regular academic terms. Useful as a canonical set of terms for joins, calendars, or term-level reporting. | Use for: List active/regular academic terms; Join term-level metrics to the current/regular term set; Filter course sections to current or regular terms

accepted.name: agg_subject_enrollment_by_term_dept
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  subject_offered.TERM_CODE,
  subject_offered.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  subject_offered.OFFER_DEPT_NAME,
  SUM(COALESCE(subject_offered.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, 0)) AS total_subject_enrollment_number,
  SUM(COALESCE(subject_offered.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_num_enrolled_students
FROM subject_offered
GROUP BY
  subject_offered.TERM_CODE,
  subject_offered.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
  subject_offered.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
accepted.description: Aggregated enrollment totals per TERM_CODE and OFFER_DEPT_CODE using subject_offered summary numbers. Useful for department-term enrollment trends and rollups. | Use for: Department-level enrollment by term; Trend of enrolled students per department over terms; Compare subject enrollment counts vs enrolled students

accepted.name: rank_latest_fclt_building_by_key
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  fclt_building.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  fclt_building.BUILDING_NAME,
  fclt_building.ASSIGNABLE_AREA,
  fclt_building.EXT_GROSS_AREA,
  fclt_building.SITE,
  fclt_building.CAMPUS_SECTOR,
  fclt_building.LATITUDE_WGS,
  fclt_building.LONGITUDE_WGS,
  fclt_building.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  RANK() OVER (
    PARTITION BY fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
    ORDER BY (fclt_building.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE IS NULL), fclt_building.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE DESC
  ) AS row_rank
FROM fclt_building
accepted.description: Window-ranked rows of fclt_building by FCLT_BUILDING_KEY with latest WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE first. Exposes row_rank so downstream queries can select latest per building (rank = 1). | Use for: Select latest building attributes per building; Time-based comparisons of building snapshots; Join latest building rows to rooms or floors

accepted.name: win_running_room_area_by_building
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  fac_rooms.BUILDING_KEY,
  fac_rooms.FLOOR,
  fac_rooms.ROOM,
  fac_rooms.AREA,
  fac_rooms.ROOM_FULL_NAME,
  SUM(COALESCE(fac_rooms.AREA, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY fac_rooms.BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY fac_rooms.ROOM ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_area
FROM fac_rooms
accepted.description: Running cumulative area per BUILDING_KEY ordered by ROOM (or ROOM identifier) within fac_rooms. Useful to compute cumulative area distributions within a building or to find rank-by-cumulative-area. | Use for: Cumulative area within a building; Identify smallest set of rooms reaching X sqft (downstream filter on running_area); Distribution of area by room order

accepted.name: reshape_subject_enrollment_by_week_flags
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  subject_summary.TERM_CODE,
  subject_summary.SUBJECT_ID,
  subject_summary.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  subject_summary.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIRST_WEEK,
  subject_summary.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_FIFTH_WEEK,
  subject_summary.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_1ST_CREDIT,
  subject_summary.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_5TH_CREDIT
FROM subject_summary
accepted.description: Pivot-like projection exposing first-week and fifth-week enrollment counts side-by-side from subject_summary for easier comparison. Useful for retention/drop analysis between weeks. | Use for: Compare first-week vs fifth-week enrollment; Compute retention rates between weeks (downstream derived ratio); Identify courses with large drop between weeks
